description: PostgREST connects to postgres over mutual TLS. addon-mtls issues client cert CN=postgrest into the certs volume (mtls/postgrest/); conf-enable-mtls-app.sh swaps the DB role to postgrest, binds /certs into the postgrest service and appends sslmode=verify-ca + sslcert/sslkey/sslrootcert to PGRST_DB_URI; postgres/mtls (addon-ssl + pg_client_cert=true) enforces hostssl ... cert. The livetest-local overlay seeds the postgrest/web_anon roles + a sample table (production proxvex creates no DB SQL — operator's job), and the post_start query check proves the full PostgREST -> PostgreSQL mTLS path end-to-end.
